description: Ready-made delivery views and snapshot commands layered on the complete core profile: a live line map, a delivery history page and tracker and forge snapshots, configured rather than coded. Merge recovery preserves source occurrence time separately from observation, with unknown timing left unknown. Views show stage-specific recorded times and compact cross-repository pull request identities. Native runless review reports use bounded observational capture and candidate-bound shared cards. Originating closure details are collapsed by default in shared review cards. Ready and merge hooks receive an exact runner-derived single or batch check mode without changing admission.
